sensitive.why: Local server: POST /event, /ear, /shutdown, ntfy pings, writes logs and clips
Plugin hooks that decide what leaves each session; also read brain
Plugin manifest and marketplace listing other installs depend on
Sends audio clips to Google using a Gemini API key
Writes summaries into the shared brain repo that syncs to GitHub
Deletes old ear clips and daily event logs
Detached background auto-start of the bridge outside any session
Spawns and restarts outside source child processes (az CLI) on its own
